correctness.rationale: Complete derivation from Brownian conditional bridges and Gaussian noise covariance. Short-gap comparison reduces to a polynomial positive by endpoint sign certificates; large gaps are excluded by an exact concave quadratic certificate; Descartes sign-variation across all positive noise variances gives exactly one optimal gap. Exact symbolic checker verifies polynomial identities and asymptotics (60 checks). Conditional formulas extend continuously to coincident/endpoints, so no hidden domain exclusion. No finite numerical sampling is used as universal proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-noise global optimum of a canonical two-sensor Gaussian-process recovery problem provides a noise-calibrated design with provably unique midreflection and a nontrivial inverse-noise collision law. It identifies that independent noisy repeated midpoint measurements are never optimal at finite noise, while fixed trisection is only optimal in the zero-noise limit; the precise spacing controls full-path reconstruction under real sensor noise, beyond an arbitrary finite slice.
